scoring_justification: The headline result is a set of extracted peak parameters from an RCWA simulation. Recomputing the full RCWA in the verifier is infeasible; instead we compare the extracted parameters to the paper-reported simulated values with appropriate tolerances, and audit the raw spectra for structural validity.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference peak parameters (central wavelength, peak reflectivity, FWHM) for CCGF-I and CCGF-II from paper's Figure 9 simulation results.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper section 4, Figure 9: CCGF-I peaks A (608.5 nm, 0.527, 13.5 nm), B (700.5 nm, 0.519, 18 nm); CCGF-II peaks C (639.5 nm, 0.535, 12 nm), D (722 nm, 0.504, 10 nm).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported simulated peak parameters.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly as reported in the paper for the simulated spectra; they are the authoritative target for reproduction.

outputs.description: CCGF-I combined reflection spectrum (TE/TM average). Used for structural audit: wavelength monotonicity, two-peak shape, reflectivity in [0,1].
CCGF-II combined reflection spectrum (TE/TM average). Used for structural audit.

items.peak_label: string (A, B for ccgf1; C, D for ccgf2)

outputs.description: Peak parameters for both CCGFs. Checked against paper-reported simulated values (hidden reference) with tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The RCWA simulations are process steps; their intermediate arrays are not scored. The peak_summary.json is the main reproduction target. The combined spectra are also scored for structural validity.

steps.description: Check CCGF-I CSV: wavelength monotonic, reflectivity in [0,1], and at least two reflection peaks present.
Check CCGF-II CSV: wavelength monotonic, reflectivity in [0,1], and at least two reflection peaks present.
Compare extracted peak central wavelength, peak reflectivity, and FWHM for the four peaks (A,B,C,D) against paper-reported simulated values within tolerances.
